description: G-45 / GA-24: the priority class a run gets from its runKind at admission, the order the classes are served in, and the vendor rate-budget priority (WP-37/38 RatePriority) each class draws at. One table for Node (domain/priority-class.ts) and the worker (app/services/rate_budget/families.py); both are tested against it. A child run is not in runKinds: it takes its parent's class. A lower-class run a person answered rises to approval_resume and never falls back.
